title: Triply AI Itinerary Generation Response
description: Structured output contract for Gemini's day-by-day itinerary generation (FR-AI-001). Enforced by the Backend AI-Orchestration module before any ItineraryDay/ItineraryItem rows are written. See TRIPLY_AI_JSON_Schema_Contract_v1.0.0.md for full rationale and the validation pipeline.

schema_version.description: Must match the version Backend is configured to accept for this generation request.

trip_id.description: Must match the Trip.id of the request that triggered this generation.

destination_id.description: Must match Trip.destination_id for the request.

days.description: Length must equal the trip's day count (end_date - start_date + 1). day_number values must be unique and contiguous starting at 1.

date.description: Must fall within [Trip.start_date, Trip.end_date] and equal start_date + day_number - 1.

order_index.description: Ordering within (day_number, time_slot). Must be unique per that pair.

place_name.description: Must exactly match an active Place.name scoped to destination_id. This is the FR-AI-002 enforcement field — 0% tolerance for unresolved names.

place_category.description: Must match PlaceCategory.code of the resolved Place row.

estimated_cost.description: Checked against the resolved Place.reference_price within the agreed cost-tolerance band (SRS D1, proposed +/-15%, pending sign-off).

notes.description: Optional free-text rationale/tip. Must not contain invented pricing or confidence claims.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, matches Trip.budget_currency_id's ISO code when set.

total.description: Must equal the sum of accommodation + transportation + food + activities + other (2dp rounding). Used only as a model coherence check — the authoritative CostEstimate rows are computed deterministically by Backend from persisted ItineraryItem data, not copied from this field.
